tagline: Everything about this machine, on one screen.
description:
System Info reads the hardware and system facts and lays them out in tabs: an overview, then CPU, memory, disks, network and sensors in detail.

Hostname, OS, kernel and uptime; CPU model, core count, frequency and load averages; RAM and swap used, free and available; every disk with its size and free space; every network interface with bytes received and sent; and temperature sensors where the machine exposes them — which most virtual servers do not, and the app says so rather than showing nothing.
capabilities: CPU: model, physical and logical cores, frequency, 1/5/15-minute load averages.
Memory: RAM and swap, used, free and available.
Disks: every mounted filesystem with size, used and free.
Network: every interface with bytes received and sent.
Temperature sensors, with a clear message when the machine has none to report.
